description: A styled, accessible table. Compose inside <Card flush> for an edge-to-edge surface. Sub-parts: THead, TBody, TFoot, Tr, Th, Td, TrGroup, TrDetail, TableEmpty, TableSkeleton. Copy: the caption names what the table lists, even when hidden — it is the table's only name for a screen reader.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Renders the header as a sort control.

props.name: sortDirection
props.description: Current sort on THIS column: 'asc' / 'desc' / null (sortable but inactive).

props.name: onSort
props.description: Called when the header is activated to change the sort.

props.name: select
props.description: The checkbox column: sized to its control instead of sharing the width.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: A row header's identifier: the record's name, in the body's ink.

props.name: width
props.description: The column's width, declared once on its header. Any CSS length, honoured under `<Table layout="fixed">`. Fix the predictable columns (status, date, actions) and let the text ones take what is left.

props.name: hideBelow
props.description: Drops this column below a breakpoint. Only for a column whose value is reachable another way: dropping a column drops data, and the identifier and the actions are never the ones to go.

props.name: heat
props.description: Paints the cell on the heatmap ramp (0 to 4), for a table read as a pattern. `tone` is the semantic fill and says good or bad.

props.name: select
props.description: The checkbox column: sized to its control instead of sharing the width.

props.name: hideBelow
props.description: Drops this cell below a breakpoint. It has to match its header's `hideBelow`, or the row and the head stop having the same columns.

props.name: count
props.description: How many rows are inside, so a collapsed group says what it hides.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: How many columns the table has, so the heading spans all of them.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Header stays while the rows scroll. It sticks to the nearest scrolling ancestor, so inside `<TableScroll>` give the wrapper a block size.

props.name: stickyFooter
props.description: Keeps `<TFoot>` on the bottom edge: a total that scrolls away is a total nobody reads.

props.name: stickyColumn
props.description: Freezes the first column: when the identifier scrolls out of view the reader is on an unnamed row.

props.name: size
props.description: Row density: md (default) / sm for dense reference tables.

props.name: nowrap
props.description: One record per line: values never wrap mid-value (a phone number broken in half reads as two numbers) and rows keep one height. It claims width, so pair it with `<TableScroll>`.

props.name: caption
props.description: The table's name, as a real `<caption>`. Give it this or an `aria-label`: a table with neither is unnamed to anyone who cannot see the heading.

props.name: captionHidden
props.description: Keeps the caption for assistive technology only, when the heading above already says the same words.

props.name: layout
props.description: Column sizing: content-driven (default) or the widths the header declares.
